insights.summary: Sales leadership uses Gong for loan officers and questions paying for Invoca QM too.
insights.quote: Our sales leadership has Gong for the loan officers, and they keep asking why we need Invoca's QM on top of it.

insights.summary: Five9 integration stamps transfer time instead of answer time, skewing speed-to-answer by ~40s on transferred calls.
insights.quote: The Five9 integration is stamping the transfer time instead of the answer time, so our speed-to-answer report is off by about forty seconds on every transferred call.

insights.summary: Wants an API endpoint for dashboard metrics to feed Looker instead of CSV exports.
insights.quote: We'd love an API endpoint for the dashboard metrics so we can pull them into Looker without the CSV export.
